groups.title: MQTT and IoT Messaging
groups.question: Explain how IoT devices usually send messages to the cloud.

followUps.MQTT Protocol and QoS Levels: How do you pick an MQTT QoS level for telemetry versus for a command that moves real hardware?
followUps.AWS IoT Core for MQTT at Scale: How does AWS IoT Core authenticate devices, and what drives its cost for a fleet that sends many small messages?

groups.title: AWS Greengrass
groups.question: Explain how AWS Greengrass lets devices do work locally.

followUps.Greengrass Local Compute: Why process and filter sensor data on the device before sending it to the cloud?
followUps.Edge ML Inference with Greengrass: Why does local ML inference matter for safety-critical devices, and how do you roll out new model versions across a fleet?

groups.title: Azure IoT Edge
groups.question: Explain how Azure IoT Edge runs and connects software on devices.

followUps.Azure IoT Edge Modules and Routes: How do IoT Edge modules pass messages to each other and up to IoT Hub?
followUps.Offline-First IoT Edge Design: What should you plan for when a device may be offline for days?

groups.title: WebSockets at the IoT Edge
groups.question: Walk through how you keep edge devices and the cloud in sync over unreliable links.

followUps.WebSocket Connections through Durable Ob: Why can a Durable Object act as a coordination point for a group of connected devices, and what limits it?
followUps.Edge-to-Cloud Synchronisation Patterns: Why is syncing desired and reported state more robust than replaying an ordered stream of events?
